note: Step 1 of the Phase 2 plan (Notion 'Phase 2: Drafter swap ablations'): every pass/fail and stop rule is fixed here BEFORE any run. Every Phase 2 output records this file's sha256. Change a rule only in a new version, never mid-run. v2 (2026-09-30, before any Phase 2 run): the benchmark list grows from 5 to 7 sets -- IFEval-541 joins the in-domain sets (instruction following is one of the three domains of the judge's round-3 training mix) and AIME joins the near-domain out-of-mix sets (competition maths, like MATH-500). No threshold changed.

alignment_hurt.rule: any in-domain set: paired delta accuracy (new drafter - S0, both judge + DES48, same items) has its 95% CI upper bound < 0, OR the probe's precision of commits above 0.95 is < 0.99

cross_domain_gain.rule: an out-of-mix set: paired delta accuracy 95% CI lower bound > 0. MATH-500 counts as near-domain; only GPQA counts as out of domain.

size_pays_off.rule: charged speedup (drafter charged at its own cost per forward) above S0's on the same set, and alignment not hurt

drafter_fits.rule: drafter-only agreement with the 30B tokens >= 0.5 x S0's agreement on the SAME blocks; else stop: the drafter does not fit this MoE

retrain_trigger.rule: retrain the LoRA judge adapter only if the zero-shot decode is 'alignment_hurt' on an in-domain set

stop._doc: Checked after EVERY unit of work (drafted item, decoded item, optimizer step, probe). metric is a key of the stage's running-metrics dict; op in <,>,<=,>=,nonfinite,true,false; threshold = value, or value x refs[ref] when ref is set (skipped, with one warning, while the ref is unknown); min_n = the stage's count (items / blocks / steps) before the rule may fire; patience = consecutive checks it must hold. action stop -> the process writes STOPPED.json and exits 3; warn -> logged to stop_events.jsonl only. A file named STOP in the run dir or in logs/phase2/ stops every stage at its next check (manual kill switch).

agreement.why: agreement near chance: a mask-id remap or vocabulary-map bug, not a weak drafter (Notion risk table)
the drafter's raw argmax is its own [MASK] on most open slots: its mask id is wrong
far below SDAR-1.7B on the same blocks: stop, the drafter does not fit this MoE (flowchart step 3)
clearly weaker than SDAR-1.7B: expect fewer confirms

probe.why: the adapter's commits above 0.95 are below 99% precise on the new drafts (pass/fail: alignment_hurt)
the probe saw almost no draft-filled rows: the redrafted index is broken

decode.why: a --stock run no longer reproduces the recorded stock cell token for token (AGENTS.md 9(i))
the S0 rerun differs from the recorded round-3 S0 cell (a new torch / GPU can do this; pair against the rerun, not the record)
the scorer fails on many items: wrong dataset family or a broken sandbox (AGENTS.md 9(b))
most generations never stop: degenerate decoding
running paired delta vs S0 is below -10 points even at its 99% upper bound: finishing cannot change the verdict (reported as stopped, verdict alignment_hurt)
in-decode draft agreement far below S0's
the judge hits its pass cap on most blocks

train.why: loss EMA 1.5x above its best for 20 consecutive steps
held-out commit precision below 99% at two consecutive probes (pass/fail floor)
held-out CE rose at 3 consecutive probes: early stop, the best probe checkpoint is kept
throughput collapsed to under 30% of its median
